tools.name: search_view
tools.description: Search accessible Geobble resources and render an interactive result grid. Use when visual selection would help the user.

tools.name: resource_view
tools.description: Fetch and render an accessible collection, project, map, or source for visual inspection.

tools.name: map_view
tools.description: Render an accessible published map with its preview, delivery state, and canonical link.

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Return the connected Geobble account: identity, display name, email, and handle. Use it to confirm which geospatial workspace is connected.

tools.name: account_list
tools.description: List the personal and organization accounts that can own new geospatial work — projects, datasets, maps, collections — including the handle the create tools require.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Describe this server's geospatial capabilities: authoring and editing GIS projects and maps, spatial analysis, publishing interactive web maps, and moving geospatial data in and out.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search accessible geospatial resources — datasets, projects, published maps, and collections — in one ordered result set. Use it to find GIS data or a map before calling the get tools.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get one accessible geospatial resource: a dataset (source), project, published map, or collection.

tools.name: map_get
tools.description: Get a published interactive map: its active publication, canonical URL, and iframe embed markup when public embedding is enabled.

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create an empty private project — the geospatial workspace holding map layers, datasets, styles, and analysis results — under an account where the caller can create.

tools.name: project_update_settings
tools.description: Merge Workspace-owned map settings into a project: camera, interactions, metadata, and computed fields, with optimistic concurrency and canonical GMS validation.

tools.name: project_explore_collection
tools.description: List and inspect the geospatial datasets in a collection attached to the project.

tools.name: project_inspect_source
tools.description: Inspect a dataset's attribute schema, provenance, freshness, and a small sample of features.

tools.name: project_validate_map
tools.description: Validate a project map: canonical GMS, renderer compatibility, referenced resources, and expected outputs.

tools.name: project_view_history_state
tools.description: Read the full map specification of a project as it was at a prior version.

tools.name: project_list_basemaps
tools.description: List the valid basemaps available to a project: light, dark, vector, raster, and DEM elevation sources.

tools.name: project_resolve_places
tools.description: Geocode place names to coordinates, or reverse geocode coordinates to place names.

tools.name: project_create_theme
tools.description: Create a reusable cartographic colour theme owned by the project account and attach it to the project.

tools.name: project_query_database
tools.description: Run read-only DuckDB SQL over the project's GeoParquet data — filter, aggregate, join, and measure features — with optional materialisation of derived datasets.

tools.name: project_run_spatial_operation
tools.description: Run a predefined spatial operation (buffer, intersect, union, clip, spatial join, proximity, dissolve) and persist derived results.

tools.name: project_analyze_mobility
tools.description: Queue provider-backed mobility analysis: routing, reachability and isochrones, nearest, travel-time metrics, or map-matching.

tools.name: project_mobility_analysis_status
tools.description: Read the status and result of a queued mobility analysis job.

tools.name: project_submit_dataset_request
tools.description: Submit a private request for missing geospatial data for the project owner, after catalogue search found nothing suitable.

tools.name: project_manage_context
tools.description: Add or remove a source, collection, symbol set, or theme from a project context. Adding a resource makes it available to project layer and query tools.

tools.name: project_set_view
tools.description: Navigate the live project camera or persist a default view. expectedSpecVersion protects persisted changes from stale writes.

tools.name: project_add_layer
tools.description: Add a map layer to a project from a dataset, collection, or map already present in its context. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_remove_layers
tools.description: Remove one or more layers from a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a map layer while preserving canonical GMS validity. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_reorder_layers
tools.description: Change the draw order of layers in a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_update_layer_style
tools.description: Merge typed paint and display properties into a map layer's symbology: colours, ramps, opacity, and stroke. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_set_layer_filter
tools.description: Set or clear a validated attribute filter controlling which features a layer draws. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_update_layer_label
tools.description: Configure or clear the label definition for a map layer. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_set_layer_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide one layer in the project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_set_layer_zoom_range
tools.description: Set a layer's minimum and maximum visible zoom levels. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_popup
tools.description: Configure popup presentation and which feature attributes appear in a project map's popups. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_search
tools.description: Configure how search behaves in a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_computed
tools.description: Configure computed feature fields and expressions for a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_bubbles
tools.description: Configure bubble interactions for a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_camera
tools.description: Configure camera interaction behaviour for a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_configure_legend
tools.description: Configure the legend of a project map and its entries. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_manage_groups
tools.description: Create, update, delete, or assign layer groups in a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: project_set_basemap
tools.description: Assign light and/or dark basemaps to a project map. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: studio_add_layer
tools.description: Add a map layer using Studio defaults and Studio-owned fields. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: studio_set_basic_popup
tools.description: Configure the basic popup fields owned by the Studio editing surface. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: studio_update_settings
tools.description: Update Studio-owned map settings, including contour lines. expectedSpecVersion is required to prevent stale writes.

tools.name: collection_create
tools.description: Create a collection — a curated group of geospatial datasets — under an accessible account.

tools.name: collection_update_metadata
tools.description: Update the title, description, and visibility metadata of a geospatial collection.

tools.name: source_prepare_upload
tools.description: Prepare a dataset upload: create a pending spatial source and return a presigned upload capability for GIS files such as GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage, KML, or CSV with coordinates.

tools.name: source_import_url
tools.description: Import a geospatial dataset from a public URL, validated against SSRF and enqueued as a bounded import.

tools.name: source_prepare_download
tools.description: Prepare a dataset download and return a short-lived download capability, or enqueue a billed export when the requested GIS format needs conversion. An optional stateless filter (bbox, typed attribute predicates, column projection, row cap) produces a snapshot export; parquet filters are computed wit

tools.name: source_download_status
tools.description: Poll a prepared geospatial export and return a fresh download capability once the format conversion is ready. Repeat the same filter used to prepare the export; a different filter is a different artifact and it is not enqueued here.

tools.name: source_update_metadata
tools.description: Update a dataset's descriptive, temporal, provenance, and review metadata.

tools.name: account_update_profile
tools.description: Preview changing the display name, about text, or phone number of an account you administer: your own profile, or an organization where you are an admin or owner. Handles are not editable here.

tools.name: resource_access_get
tools.description: Inspect effective access to a geospatial resource: visibility, inheritance, and individual or organization shares.

tools.name: resource_change_visibility
tools.description: Preview publishing or unpublishing a resource.

tools.name: resource_share_grant
tools.description: Preview granting a user, organization, or public share.

tools.name: resource_share_revoke
tools.description: Preview revoking an existing share.

tools.name: map_publish
tools.description: Preview publishing a project as a new immutable map revision. Set targetMapId and expectedCurrentPublicationId to republish an existing map.

tools.name: map_publication_list
tools.description: List the immutable publication revisions of a map and identify which revision is live.

tools.name: map_publication_activate
tools.description: Preview rolling a map forward or back to an immutable publication revision.

tools.name: map_image_export_prepare
tools.description: Create or reuse an asynchronous PNG image export of a project map or published map.

tools.name: map_image_export_status
tools.description: Poll a map image export and return a download capability once the PNG is rendered.

tools.name: resource_delete
tools.description: Preview moving a source, collection, map, or project to trash.

tools.name: resource_restore
tools.description: Restore an eligible dataset, collection, map, or project from trash.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Execute the exact server-stored action from a confirmation_required response, such as publishing a map or granting access.

tools.name: cancel_action
tools.description: Invalidate a pending Geobble confirmation without executing the underlying action.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search accessible geospatial resources — datasets, projects, published maps, and collections — in one ordered result set. Use it to find GIS data or a map befor…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: map_get · Private data: project_create, project_query_database, project_submit_dataset_request, source_prepare_upload · Public sink: profile, project_submit_dataset_request, source_prepare_upload, resource_share_grant, resource_share_revoke, map_publish, map_publication_activate · Destructive: project_query_database, project_run_spatial_operation, project_manage_context, project_remove_layers, project_manage_groups, source_prepare_download, source_download_status, resource_delete, confirm_action.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: map_get · Private data: project_create, project_query_database, project_submit_dataset_request, source_prepare_upload · Public sink: profile, project_submit_dataset_request, source_prepare_upload, resource_share_grant, resource_share_revoke, map_publish, map_publication_activate · Destructive: project_query_database, project_run_spatial_operation, project_manage_context, project_remove_layers, project_manage_groups, source_prepare_download, source_download_status, resource_delete, confirm_action

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
